## What changed?

Briefly describe the source addition or correction and the public evidence supporting it.

## Checklist

- [ ] I changed only the relevant state file(s) and supporting project documentation, if needed.
- [ ] Every submitted meeting source is a continuing collection, not one meeting or one downloadable artifact.
- [ ] I included a public `meeting_source_evidence_url` showing that the body operates or authorizes the source.
- [ ] Newly identified meeting sources are marked `unverified` unless a maintainer has completed review.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private information, copied third-party prose, parser code, or meeting content.
- [ ] If I used an AI assistant, I personally reviewed its proposed changes and opened both the meeting-source and evidence links.
- [ ] I ran `python .github/scripts/validate_catalog.py --fix-readme` successfully.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this catalog contribution under CC0 1.0 Universal, or this supporting software contribution under the MIT License, as applicable.
